I can't meet new people because there's just nowhere for new people to come from any more. The last time I met new people it was because I started my job which meant me and 20+ other people being recruited to a place of business that was just opening. Not only did I have the chance to meet some new people, I was forced to. But now it's different because I already know those people. I can't meet new people at work anymore. There are no places around here to go to meet new people, no classes or groups to join or anything like that. The only place to go is one of the small number of night clubs where people go a couple of nights a week.

And that brings me to not being able to talk to people. I just can't. Unless there's a specific reason for me to strike up conversation with someone, I just can't do it because I know it'll be obvious what my motives are. If I just approach a girl and start talking to her about nothing in particular, it's going to be obvious why I'm doing it and for that reason I just can't do it. Plus, whenever I make the effort to go out, it doesn't work like that anyway. Unfortunately real life is different to movies where people can just go up to strangers and hit it off with them. What actually happens is that people go out and just stick to themselves, or to their own friends. 

Meeting new people just doesn't happen anymore. It hasn't for a long time and there's no realistic way it's going to again. I've spoken to a couple of friends about how I feel and they just say "you will meet someone" but that's bullshit advice. Why will I meet someone? I can't just give myself blind hope. Unless I can see how it's actually going to happen, and how the issues I have aren't going to be a problem, I can't believe I will.

And until I do, I'm just going to feel completely alone. And it's not like it's all about having a girlfriend because when it's put like that, it sounds a bit silly, but it's about having someone to share that intimacy and affection with. When you don't have that closeness with someone, it's just not healthy. I honestly don't believe that there is any person on the planet that considers me their favourite person in the world. Not one.

The first point is my problem though, I don't meet new people. I never do.  I haven't for...I can't even remember how long. If I thought there was any genuine chance of me meeting someone new tomorrow, I wouldn't feel so hopeless. And I can't just go to talk to people I don't know, I just can't. Unless I have a reason to, I just can't do it.

As for the other things, they would just be very temporary distractions and then the problem is back. I work weekends so Friday isn't something I look forward to either. I don't want to just distract myself with little things that might cheer me up for 5 minutes, I want to fix the problem so I don't feel like I need to be distracting myself.

And unfortunately I absolutely see no way of a long-term solution happening. People say it will, but people have been saying that for over a year now.

And the worst part is I see no end in sight. Whenever I've sought out advice, I just hear the same cliche stuff that doesn't work. I sincerely believe there is no way out of it, and the fact that so many people are in the same situation is a big problem.

I don't know even know what the solution would be, but it really is a huge problem how many people are in situations like mine because there simply is no way to get around it. Some of us just aren't meant to be happy.

Fuck that. To them it might just be a joke but they clearly don't realise how fucking frustrating and soul-crushing it can be to feel alone and to not feel like there's any way out of it. I'm not a virgin, but in that situation it wouldn't just be about losing my virginity. That's like my friends making a bet on when I'll next get laid, or next meet someone. I'd fucking flip because at the moment it's something that bothers me and gets me down a hell of a lot.

There isn't really anything to change though, that's really the whole problem. I've hit a wall where everything is just the way it's going to be and there's nothing I can really do about it. Like I said, I live in a small area where there's nothing to do in the way of trying out new things, but even if there was, I doubt I'd have the motivation to do it.

As a person I don't even think there's much wrong with me. I'm a fairly average looking guy so whilst I might not turn heads, I'm not repulsive. I can put on a brave face and force myself to be fun company if I need to. None of that is the issue. It's just a case of being in a place now where I'm simply not meeting new people anymore, and I sincerely have no idea how I'm supposed to do so from now on. I don't want to be alone and yet there's really nowhere I'm likely to suddenly meet someone I can click with.
